text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A killer storm in eastern Sabah state on Christmas day has killed more than 100 people with another 100 still missing.
- Singapore's United Overseas Bank plans to merge its two Malaysian banking units, United Overseas (Malaysia) Bhd and Chung Khiaw Bank (Malaysia) Bhd, by early next year.

- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad has asked Selangor Chief Minister Muhammad Muhammad Taib to submit a report on Muhammad's alleged failure to declare A$1.2 million cash at Brisbane airport on Sunday.
- Indonesia has agreed that a Malaysian will be the next executive director of the International Natural Rubber Organisation, ending a year-long dispute between the two countries
